object_description: two new buildings enclosing a school square above an embedded gymnasium
design_condition: Two new buildings frame the existing main building and define upper and lower levels, embedding the gymnasium into the topographical edge while creating a forecourt, schoolyard, and sports fields.

positive.statement: The two new buildings clearly define the school square and create a harmonious ensemble.

position.target: two new buildings and school square
position.rationale: Two visible masses frame a clear open interval in plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The gymnasium is effectively embedded using the topographical edge and level difference.

position.rationale: The low, embedded base is identifiable at the lower-left side of the sampled composition.

positive.statement: The main entrances are logically located on the central playground.

position.rationale: Entrances are constrained to the central playground edge between the two buildings.

positive.statement: The auditorium creates a strong vertical spatial relationship and strengthens the school's inner identity.

position.rationale: The auditorium is approximated as an upper-volume interior anchor near the central relationship.

positive.statement: The school clusters offer a variety of possible uses and an impressive spatial experience.

position.rationale: The two-storey building arrangement is clearly represented in plan and repeated elevation bands.

positive.statement: The studio zone has high utilization potential.

position.rationale: The studio zone is approximated within the right-hand upper building volume.

positive.statement: The open-space qualities are complemented by natural play areas, a school garden, and open sports fields.

position.target: natural play areas, school garden, and sports fields
position.rationale: Open exterior areas are distributed around the courtyard-forming masses and lower edge.

negative.statement: The two existing neighboring buildings may not be able to fulfill their new role on the school playground.

position.rationale: The neighboring-building role is approximated outside the main courtyard-forming pair.

negative.statement: The urban design creates a strong separation between the lower and upper levels, landscape, and courtyard.

position.target: lower and upper levels, landscape, and courtyard
position.rationale: The model visibly separates a framed courtyard and distinct horizontal elevation levels.

negative.statement: The terrace is not sufficiently connected to the central playground for the two spaces to enter into a dialogue.

position.rationale: The terrace-playground relationship is anchored in the central open interval between masses.

negative.statement: The accentuated street space and the parking-lot location in front of the classrooms are not convincing.

position.rationale: The street-facing outer edge is used as the approximate parking and street-space location.

negative.statement: The north facade still requires further development.

position.rationale: The rear boundary and its long elevation are clearly localized at the north side.

negative.statement: The connection to the equipment rooms and the location of the trainers' changing rooms still need to be rearranged.

position.target: equipment rooms and trainers' changing rooms
position.rationale: Service and changing functions are approximated in the lower embedded volume.

negative.statement: The structural concept appears to fail because the large recesses severely restrict the shear flow.

position.rationale: Recesses are approximated along the central courtyard-facing building edges.

negative.statement: The structural solution remains costly, especially because a more ecological lightweight construction method was abandoned.

position.rationale: Cost and construction-method criticism has no uniquely identifiable exterior model marker.

negative.statement: The ensemble appears rather hermetic, with little invitation to walk through it.

position.rationale: The full composition appears as a compact, visually enclosing arrangement with limited through-route.
